bodyHtml:
Tuesday, November 17 is Suguk-seonyeol-ui Nal, Korea's Memorial Day for the Patriotic Martyrs - a solemn observance, not a public holiday, honoring the independence fighters who died for the country between 1905 and 1945. The date was chosen deliberately: it marks the day in 1905 Korea was forced to sign the Eulsa Treaty, and the observance itself turns 87 this year, first held by the government-in-exile back in 1939. In the Saju calendar, today is an Eulmi (乙未) day - Yin Wood (乙) sitting on the Goat's branch (未). The Goat's hidden stems run Fire-Wood-Earth, and that buried Wood is the same element as today's own stem, which means Wood finally has something to root into after days of burning straight through fire with nothing to hold it. The sixty-day nayin table stays quiet too: today is only the second day of Sajung-geum (沙中金), Metal Hidden in Sand, opened yesterday - no new name, no new element, just the same buried metal left exactly where it was. Two days before Suneung, on a day built for remembering rather than rushing, here are the three zodiac animals reading today's grounded, rooted energy best.

1. Pig - Opening the Same Wood Current That Settles in Today's Goat

Pig anchors the opening point of the Wood trine today's Goat belongs to - Pig-Rabbit-Goat (亥卯未) - the spark that starts a three-branch current which ends up stored exactly where today sits. For Pig, that means an old plan or half-finished intention quietly has somewhere real to land today. Starting isn't the hard part anymore; today, starting actually counts.

2. Rabbit - Where the Wood Trine Is Still Moving

Rabbit sits at the living middle of that same Pig-Rabbit-Goat current, the point where the energy is neither just beginning nor already settled but actually flowing. That suits a day like today well: steady, unglamorous progress - one more page read, one more rep done, one more conversation had - adds up faster than it looks. Don't wait for a dramatic push; the middle of the current does the work on its own.

3. Horse - The Six-Harmony Partner Today's Earth Doesn't Have to Chase

Horse forms a direct six-harmony bond with today's Goat branch (午未), a tie that outranks even shared elements and needs no fire to light it. For Horse, that means a relationship or commitment that's already settled keeps holding without any extra effort today - a friend who checks in unprompted, a plan that stays firm without a reminder. Today rewards trusting what's already steady rather than testing it again.

Not One of Today's Three? That's Fine.
